description: This file declares callback functions for the CAN Interface (CanIf) module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform. It includes function prototypes for transmission confirmation, reception indication, error handling, and controller events.

methods.name: CanIf_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Callback invoked upon transmission confirmation for a specific PDU.

methods.name: CanIf_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of a CAN message with specified parameters.

methods.name: CanIf_CancelTxConfirmation
methods.description: Callback to cancel transmission confirmation, enabled when CAN transmit cancellation is configured.

methods.name: CanIf_ControllerBusOff
methods.description: Handles bus-off event for a specified CAN controller.

methods.name: CanIf_SetWakeupEvent
methods.description: Sets a wake-up event for a specified controller.

methods.name: CanIf_Arc_Error
methods.description: Extension-specific callback to handle CAN errors for a controller.
